palindrome:
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A Toyota. Never odd or even. Madam In Eden, I'm Adam. Race car. A man a plan a canal Panama. Step on no pets. Was it a car or a cat I saw? No lemon no melon. 

Here's an additional palindrome for you: "Able was I ere I saw Elba, and by the way, I just saw a civic racecar that went by at noon. Did you know that radar is a word that's spelled the same backward and forward?"
